title: Sphinx lesson
description: A lesson or reading guide: lesson.json plus lesson.md (and lesson.<lang>.md for translations) in one folder. A reading guide keeps lesson.md short and lists curated readings. See docs/content-guide.md#reading-guides.

topic.description: The unit key this lesson belongs to (from a subject.json), e.g. "NumberSystems".

minutes.description: Reading time. Defaults to an estimate from the text.

requires.description: Units the student should know first, by unit key (for example "Loops" from Java Programming). Shown with the student's progress in each unit; never enforced.

objectives.description: What a student can do after the unit, as things they do: "Convert a number between binary and decimal". Shown at the top of the lesson.

readings.description: Curated readings from the web (reading guides). They open in the browser. Put <!-- readings --> in lesson.md where the cards should appear; without it they go after the text.

source.description: Who published it, e.g. "Cloudflare Learning Center".

url.description: A free page, without login or paywall.

minutes.description: About how long it takes to read or watch.

lookFor.description: What to pay attention to while reading.

subject.description: The subject (for example "cs"), for content without a unit. Otherwise the unit decides the subject.

readings.description: The translated "lookFor" of each reading, in the same order.

translations.description: By language, e.g. { "pt-br": { "title": "…" } }. The text goes in lesson.<lang>.md.
